text:
CLEOPATRA:
  I feel sick and miserable.
ANTONY:
  I'm sorry I have to tell you what I'm planning—
CLEOPATRA:
  Help me out of here, Charmian dear! I'm going to faint.
  This can't go on much longer.
  My body can't take it.
ANTONY:
  Now, my dearest queen—
CLEOPATRA:
  Please, stand further away from me.
ANTONY:
  What's wrong?
CLEOPATRA:
  I can see it in your eyes. There's some good news.
  What, has your wife said you can go home?
  I wish she'd never let you come here at all!
  Don't let her say I'm the one keeping you here.
  I have no hold on you. You belong to her.
